body: app/http_client.py get() makes a single attempt: transient 5xx responses and network errors fail the job immediately. Add retry: up to 3 retries (4 attempts total) with exponential backoff starting at 100ms (100ms, 200ms, 400ms), retrying 5xx responses and network errors only. Never retry 4xx — those raise HttpError immediately. Acceptance: a 5xx-then-success sequence returns the body; a persistent 5xx raises HttpError after 4 attempts; a 4xx raises HttpError after exactly 1 attempt; existing tests still pass.
title: Add retry with backoff to the HTTP client wrapper
